name: Accent Auto Repair
hook: Your customers on Greenbush Street get Thomas himself on the phone six days a week and a night drop when they can't make it — the ones still choosing a shop could see that, your services and a booking button on accentauto.us from their phone. We built a trial version of that page. Take a look:
fakt: you run Accent Auto Repair as owner/operator in the old FinishMasters building on Greenbush Street, you're open Monday to Saturday with a night drop, you do everything from computer diagnostics and drivability problems to timing kits, water pumps and engine replacement, and you already own accentauto.us
na_stronie: your name, phone, e-mail and the Greenbush Street address up front, your services in your own words (complete computer diagnostics, complete safety analysis, drivability problems, tune-ups, oil changes, tire repair, brake repair, mufflers and exhaust work), Monday–Saturday until 6 pm with the night drop, online booking and a contact form that lands in your inbox, your own photo of the Kia on the lift — the rest of the photos we add from you
dlaczego: Somebody who searches for a mechanic in Lafayette on a Saturday afternoon needs to see in ten seconds that you're open, what you fix and how to book. A page on accentauto.us that does that catches them before the next shop does.
